function.name: block_card
function.description: Blocks a verified customer's lost, stolen, or misused card so it can no longer be used. Pass the card (last 4 digits, or debit or credit), the reason in the caller's words, and confirmed. If you don't know which card yet, leave confirmed out; the tool says which card it found and the exact question to ask. Only after the caller clearly says yes to a specific card, set confirmed to yes.

security_answer.description: The security answer the caller gave when verifying

card.description: Last 4 digits of the card, or debit or credit. Leave out if only one card.

reason.description: Why, in the caller's words, for example lost, stolen, or charges I did not make

confirmed.description: yes only if the caller clearly said yes to blocking this specific card. Otherwise leave out.
